name: Ghoul
location: Abandoned buildings and ruins on land
behavior: Melee attacker. Rushes in, swings, and counters if you trade hits. One is met with an axe already in its head — they were people once.
weakness: Axe swings with disciplined spacing: hit, back off before the counter, repeat. Do not trade hits — health does not regenerate quickly. If two group up, retreat to a narrow spot.
description: The demo's basic land enemy. Ghouls gate the ruins and teach the melee loop early. The Serrated Axe Edge upgrade makes forced encounters noticeably faster.

name: Giant Tentacle
behavior: Rises beside the boat and strikes it, dealing hull damage. Appears as part of the night-travel risk rather than as a fought enemy.
weakness: Keep moving and stay inside the cabin line of safety; do not linger on open water after dark without a repaired hull.
description: The tentacle that attacks the trawler at night, seen in the game's key art and night encounters. It punishes greedy night routes rather than blocking them.

name: Betsy
location: Trading Post — she is the Betsy and Sons building
behavior: A walking building on crab legs. Completely harmless; Gill and Bozur run the shop inside her.
description: The giant crab that carries the trading post on her back. The shop is named after her: Betsy and Sons. She is a landmark, a shopkeeper's home and the game's most distinctive creature in one.

name: Giant Turtle
behavior: A colossal turtle used as scripted transport between areas.
description: A gentle giant that serves as living transport. Encounters are scripted travel moments rather than combat.

name: Spitting Coral
location: Coral growths, including approaches to Angler's Island
behavior: Launches projectiles when you get close. Not a creature, but it behaves like one.
weakness: Time your crossings and never stand still in its range. Note the glowing coral on Angler's Island is a different, harmless resource node.
description: A hostile coral variety that punishes careless harvesting routes. Learn to read coral patches before walking into them.

name: Blight Fog
location: Blighted zones along the Blight Line
behavior: Sea Blight made visible. Lingering inside damages you over time.
weakness: Leave the area; use medicine if caught inside. Plan routes around dense fog banks.
description: The environmental edge of the Sea Blight. Fog, silence and distance are DREADMOOR's core tension tools, and Blight Fog is the sharpest of the three.

name: Blue Salvage Creature
location: On the water surface around the Trading Post approaches
behavior: Small blue creatures drifting on the water. Harmless; they are a resource, not a threat.
weakness: Pull them in with the Hook Gun to collect Bug Slime.
description: The source of Bug Slime, one of the most-used crafting materials in the demo. Gather extra whenever you cross their water — hull repairs consume it steadily.
